title: Six fixed binary recipes retain native evolution and recovery through 6D
summary: Six published recipes pass sequential native evolution and recovery through 6D on every width-seven source state, with fixed parent completions and measured dimensional costs.
takeaway: The finite native/recovery pilot passes. The later affine-oriented theorem proves existence for arbitrary binary finite-memory parents and recursion through every fixed finite depth; this pilot remains finite verification, not that proof.
